mentions.name: SBproxy
mentions.description: SBproxy is an open source API and AI gateway packaged as a single binary. It sits between applications and LLM providers to give more control over AI traffic, positioned as 'Cloudflare meets LiteLLM'. Its single-binary distribution avoids exposing provider API keys via pip-installed gateway packages.
mentions.problem: LLM gateways hold every provider API key, which makes running one as a pip install a supply chain security risk, as highlighted by the LiteLLM supply chain hack.
